args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test failure.
Align the implementation with the spec and tests.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as using banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This mismatch caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`, matching the docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/money-half-even` (sha `08d3cd5986`): passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/money-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
